Chapter 6875: Allies

Chapter 6875: Allies

“Netherlight, that’s all three from Devouring Abyss.” Goldsilver Tree remarked.

Netherlight, Big-foot, and Southconch also wanted the primordial banner, not just the world’s heart.

“Fallen Ten has no business here. Leave.” Netherlight uttered coldly.

Both have fought before and were evenly matched. Conflicts were normal occurrences in Devouring Alliance even during Mang’s or Zhao Dachui’s reign. However, since they were stronger, they kept it to a minimum.

Immortal Emperor Gu Chun was in charge but couldn’t do the same, hence rising animosity within the parties.

Due to the decline of Fallen Ten, those from Devouring Abyss never held back with their words.

“Hahaha.” Extinguish couldn’t help but laugh: “Netherlight, you wag your tail after a little bit of success. How strong do you think your faction is?”

“Enough to destroy Fallen Ten. It is not too late to leave before it becomes unfriendly.” Netherlight said.

“Destroy our Fallen Ten?” A figure spoke and teleported continuously. Even the grand immortals couldn’t spot his true form.

“Buzz.” It didn’t take long before space became filled with afterimages.

“Mirage, no need to act mysterious, show yourself.” Netherlight said.

As the figures converged, they also pulled dimensions together. The waves were devastating and could destroy worlds. They came together to form a celestial being made from stars.

“Mirage is here too...” Goldsilver sat on the ground and said softly.

Extinguish and Mirage were from different branches, the lucky surviving immortals of Fallen Ten. In the past, they had ten great immortal monarchs and numerous immortals. Now, only two remained. This was why Netherlight looked down on them.

“Netherlight, you were playing in the mud when we reigned.” Mirage spoke. When people looked up, they saw a whole galaxy making up his body.

“Men do not dwell on past glories.” Netherlight sneered: “The heart is ours, back off.”

“Hahaha.” Mirage and Extinguish exchanged glances and laughed.

“You’ve grown bold, Netherlight, you didn’t dare to look up back then.” Extinguish said.

They were from the same generation as Zhao Dachui while Netherlight was only a junior. He became an immortal at the same time as Immortal Devourer.

“You’re old now, perhaps your faction shouldn’t exist anymore.” Netherlight uttered coldly.

“Don’t be so sure of victory.” Mirage said.

“Two decrepit immortals can’t amount to anything.” Netherlight wanted to repay the humiliation of the past when he had to lower his head to Fallen Ten.

“Fine, we shall slay you today.” Mirage said, not allowing a junior to ride on their head. Killing Netherlight would spread the message that the seniors were still in charge.

“We’re on the same side, no need to fight.” Someone interjected from behind.

“Who?!” Both Mirage and Extinguish looked back while retreating.

Space rippled, allowing a short figure to walk out. He wore a golden robe that resembled celestial feathers, giving the feeling of ascension.

Despite his stature, he exuded an unfathomable sense of weight. With just one step, he could crush space and the hearts of all immortals.
